changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: RSDEV-1525: Galaxy API keys live in the encrypted UserConnection table, which GalaxyService reads; remove the plaintext copies kept as Galaxy app settings, and the GALAXY_APIKEY setting itself, as PyRAT and DSW already do.
changeSet.sql:
delete from AppConfigElement where appConfigElementDescriptor_id in ( select d.id from AppConfigElementDescriptor d join PropertyDescriptor pd on d.descriptor_id = pd.id join App a on d.app_id = a.id where a.name = 'app.galaxy' and pd.name = 'GALAXY_APIKEY');
delete from AppConfigElementDescriptor where app_id in (select id from App where name = 'app.galaxy') and descriptor_id in (select id from PropertyDescriptor where name = 'GALAXY_APIKEY');
